absent: Conditions selecting between alt_1 and alt_2 variants for sanitizer, diagnostic, branch, type and context analysis helpers.
Full definitions of ftrace_likely_data and ftrace_branch_data and behavior of ftrace_likely_update.
Semantics and enforcement of thread safety capability attributes and overloadable helpers beyond annotation names.
Configuration controls for KASAN_ABI_VERSION, coverage, KMSAN, shadow call stack and stack erasure.
Definitions of referenced but unrouted helpers such as diag push and pop, same type test, string annotation test and memory barrier.
Layout and runtime consumers of kentry, addressable, jump table and ftrace branch sections.
Exact inline assembly constraint meanings and toolchain version support beyond stated thresholds.

findings.text: Clang sanitizer opt-outs provide per-declaration exclusion from thread, undefined behavior, memory, kernel memory, coverage, stack erase and shadow call stack instrumentation. Helpers named __no_sanitize_thread and __no_sanitize_undefined and __no_sanitize_memory and __no_kmsan_checks and __no_sanitize_coverage and __no_kstack_erase and __noscs each have an active variant carrying a compiler marker and an empty variant expanding to nothing, with stack erase reusing coverage exclusion. Choice between variants is configuration dependent.

GCC sanitizer opt-outs provide per-declaration exclusion from address including hardware assisted form, thread, undefined behavior, coverage, memory and kernel memory checking plus shadow call stack. Helpers named __no_sanitize_address and __no_sanitize_thread and __no_sanitize_undefined and __no_sanitize_coverage and __no_sanitize_memory and __no_kmsan_checks and __noscs each have an active marked form and an empty form. Memory and kernel memory helpers are empty in the shown GCC fragment. Selection depends on hidden configuration.

Availability markers __HAVE_BUILTIN_BSWAP32__ and __HAVE_BUILTIN_BSWAP64__ and __HAVE_BUILTIN_BSWAP16__ signal that the compiler supplies byte swap operations for four byte, eight byte and two byte widths. Both Clang and GCC fragments define the same three markers. Consumers can test presence rather than compiler identity.

KASAN_ABI_VERSION identifies the kernel address sanitizer interface revision expected from the compiler. One variant reports value 5 and the other reports value 4. Callers use the value to match instrumentation calling conventions.

Compiler capability facts encode version and inline assembly operand forms. GCC_VERSION combines major, minor and patch numbers with major weighted by 10000 and minor by 100. CC_HAS_TYPEOF_UNQUAL reports whether unqualified typeof is supported, using a Clang major and minor threshold of 19 and zero in one fragment and a GCC major threshold of 14 in the other. ASM_INPUT_G and ASM_INPUT_RM and ASM_OUTPUT_RM name operand constraint selections for general input, register input and write only register output.

Diagnostic control helpers abstract compiler pragma handling. Core helpers named __diag and __diag_str and __diag_str1 build a pragma from a severity and option text. Per compiler front ends named __diag_clang and __diag_GCC dispatch by version and severity, with severity words for ignore and warn and error. Version gated wrappers named __diag_clang_23 and __diag_GCC_8 apply the pragma only on matching compilers and are empty otherwise, while __diag_clang_all and __diag_GCC_all always apply. Convenience named __diag_ignore_all suppresses one option for all versions.

Context analysis vocabulary declares lock capabilities and access requirements for static checking. Type marker __ctx_lock_type plus __reentrant_ctx_lock designate lock capable types. Acquisition and release markers named __acquires_ctx_lock and __acquires_shared_ctx_lock and __try_acquires_ctx_lock and __try_acquires_shared_ctx_lock and __releases_ctx_lock and __releases_shared_ctx_lock and __returns_ctx_lock annotate transfer of exclusive or shared ownership. Requirement markers named __requires_ctx_lock and __requires_shared_ctx_lock and __excludes_ctx_lock and __assumes_ctx_lock and __assumes_shared_ctx_lock state needed, forbidden or asserted holdings. Data markers __guarded_by and __pt_guarded_by bind protected data to a lock. An alternate group defines every marker as empty when analysis is disabled.

Lock type construction and token instances plus manipulation helpers complete the analysis model. Builder named context_lock_struct creates a lock capable structure together with acquire, shared acquire, try acquire, release and assume operations for exclusive and shared modes. Token helpers named token_context_lock and token_context_lock_instance declare externally defined global lock tokens and typed instances. When analysis is off the builder reduces to a plain structure and helpers named __acquire_ctx_lock and __acquire_shared_ctx_lock and __try_acquire_ctx_lock and __try_acquire_shared_ctx_lock and __release_ctx_lock and __release_shared_ctx_lock and __assume_ctx_lock and __assume_shared_ctx_lock become empty statements or pass through of a status value.

Familiar lock annotation aliases layer over the context primitives for exclusive and shared use. Requirement aliases named __must_hold and __must_not_hold and __must_hold_shared restate required and excluded holdings. Effect aliases named __acquires and __releases and __acquires_shared and __releases_shared restate ownership transfer. Action aliases named __acquire and __release and __acquire_shared and __release_shared restate inline acquire and release. Conditional acquisition uses __cond_acquires and __cond_acquires_shared selected by __cond_acquires_impl_true family for true, false, nonzero, zero, nonnull and null spellings, with negated not variants and __cond_releases combining release plus failed acquisition. Wrappers __acquire_ret and __acquire_shared_ret evaluate a call then annotate the returned lock, while __acquires_ret and __acquires_shared_ret disable analysis for dynamic returns.

Branch prediction and condition tracing have instrumented and plain builds. Names likely and unlikely and likely_notrace and unlikely_notrace and if provide hints for expected outcomes. Instrumented build records per site static data through helpers __branch_check__ and __trace_if_var and __trace_if_value, updating counters or ftrace records. Plain build maps directly to compiler expectation hints without side effects. Selection between builds is configuration dependent.

Per site branch records carry source identity and outcome counts. Annotated branch record holds function name, file name and line number and participates in a dedicated ftrace annotated branch section with aligned placement. Condition record holds function name, file name and line number plus two counters for taken and not taken paths in a dedicated ftrace branch section with aligned placement. Fragments show use sites only, not full type definitions.

Barrier, optimizer hiding, relocation hiding and non return helpers control code motion. barrier_data pins a pointer in a register with memory clobber. barrier_before_unreachable has an empty loop form and a volatile empty assembly form. OPTIMIZER_HIDE_VAR forces a value through an opaque register move. RELOC_HIDE adds an offset to a pointer, with a GCC form hiding the computation behind empty assembly and a generic form using plain arithmetic. absolute_pointer builds a pointer from an absolute numeric value. unreachable combines the pre unreachable barrier with a compiler trap hint.

Identity, addressability, control flow integrity and entry helpers manage symbol references. __UNIQUE_ID builds a distinct name from a base and a counter. ___ADDRESSABLE and __ADDRESSABLE emit a used pointer to a symbol into a discardable addressable section. KCFI_REFERENCE either references a symbol for type integrity or expands to nothing. KENTRY declares an external symbol and stores its address in a dedicated kentry section. __annotate_jump_table either places a jump table in a read only data section or expands to nothing.

Compile time type and value classification supports safe generic code. Array checks named __is_array and __must_be_array and __is_byte_array and __must_be_byte_array distinguish arrays and single byte element arrays. String annotation checks named __is_cstr and __is_noncstr with must variants __must_be_cstr and __must_be_noncstr distinguish NUL terminated and non terminated pointers, with a fallback where both report true. TYPEOF_UNQUAL selects unqualified typeof when available else plain typeof. Value checks __is_constexpr and statically_true and const_true and is_signed_type and is_unsigned_type classify constant expressions and signedness.

__BUILD_BUG_ON_ZERO_MSG yields a zero valued integer expression that optionally enforces a compile time failure. One variant always yields zero. The other variant sizes a structure containing a static assertion so that a true error condition fails compilation with a supplied message. Array and string must helpers build on this to reject unsuitable arguments without runtime cost.

Two small entry points convert or escape values. offset_to_ptr derives a data pointer from a stored integer displacement added to its own address. _context_unsafe_alias accepts a pointer to pointer and performs no action, reached through wrapper context_unsafe_alias that hides aliasing from context analysis.

Context analysis scope control enables selective suppression. disable_context_analysis pushes diagnostic state and ignores unknown warning plus thread safety families, while enable_context_analysis pops the state. __no_context_analysis marks a declaration as exempt from checking. context_unsafe evaluates supplied statements between disable and enable. __context_unsafe provides an attribute form of exemption carrying a comment. Alternate forms define all three controls as empty when analysis is unavailable. Include guards _LINUX_COMPILER_CONTEXT_ANALYSIS_H and __LINUX_COMPILER_H prevent multiple inclusion.

Hiding strength and emitted address visibility differ by variant. Generic RELOC_HIDE and absolute_pointer use ordinary arithmetic that the optimizer can see, while the GCC RELOC_HIDE form conceals the addition behind opaque assembly, so address derivation may be optimized differently. KENTRY and addressable helpers emit symbol addresses into dedicated sections, creating persistent references that keep symbols reachable and may expose addresses. barrier_before_unreachable differences mean trap reachability assumptions vary by toolchain.

Compilation mode markers record sanitizer and code generation properties. __SANITIZE_MEMORY__ and __SANITIZE_ADDRESS__ indicate memory and address sanitizer builds. __latent_entropy requests latent entropy instrumentation on a function. prevent_tail_call_optimization inserts a memory barrier to inhibit tail calls.
